Alger, 4 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 4, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications is making the Insat digital portal available to users. This one-stop shop allows users to submit and track complaints online regarding the internet, telephony, postal services, and e-banking.
Centralisation des doléances sur le guic: Centralization of grievances on the Insat one-stop shop
Le Ministère de la Poste et des Télécomm: The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications is deploying the Insat portal (insat.mpt.gov.dz) to enable citizens to register their reports remotely. The platform consolidates the management of anomalies relating to telecommunication services, postal activities, and e-banking operations, sparing users from having to travel to an agency.
Grâce à un menu déroulant, les abonnés s: Using a drop-down menu, subscribers select the category corresponding to their issue. The system handles internet and telephony connection failures, parcel delivery incidents, CCP and CNEP account management, as well as malfunctions related to Edahabia cards and the BaridiMob application.
Procédure de signalement et suivi en lig: Procedure for reporting and online case tracking
L'introduction d'un dossier s'effectue d: Submitting a case is done directly on the website by entering personal contact details (last name, first name, phone number, email, wilaya, and address). The user then designates the concerned organization, details the nature of the request, and can upload digital supporting documents such as invoices or screenshots.
Une fois le formulaire validé, un numéro: Once the form is validated, a reference number is immediately assigned to the user. This identifier makes it possible to monitor the progress of the request processing, from initial analysis to the effective resolution of the malfunction. The time required for restoration varies depending on the technical complexity of the outage or the need for an intervention on the physical network.
Le portail Insat centralise le traitemen: The Insat portal centralizes the processing of complaints for the post and telecommunications sector.
Les usagers peuvent déclarer des pannes: Users can report internet outages, Edahabia and BaridiMob e-banking issues, or postal anomalies.
La plateforme permet de fournir des pièc: The platform makes it possible to provide supporting documents and track the case using an assigned number.
Le système prend également en charge les: The system also handles administrative requests related to licenses governed by Law 18-04.
